notes.title: Halloween is upon us
notes.content:
[h1]Hear ye, hear ye![/h1]

As darkness looms upon us there are some new sights to be seen.

We have prepared a couple of new hats themed for the season as well as patching some minor bugs that didn't fit the theme in celebration of the holiday.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25107044/0f648a266768cece2bb7ac151e96d36141f05841.png[/img]
Above is one of the new hats and my personal favorite. We also have a witch's hat, a jack o' lantern and a spooky skull for your funklift truck to wear.

Have a nice holiday,
Victor

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 4 new halloween themed hats
[*]Fixed some particle effects for showing bonus goods emitting long after they shouldn't
[/list]

notes.title: Trading Cards and a Cool new Hat
notes.content:
And it's finally time for an update and our first ever sale! We've been held up with a lot of other things but finally we found some time to give Funklift some love. There are now trading cards available and I must say they're looking really nice.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/items/470140/42bcd2f4451d32f80b4dbddfeadd738f72cf31d0.png[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/items/470140/d70ae9c601035c4372f93e4dd0fbbefb83c73ba4.png[/img]

We are also celebrating our office neighbours Guru Games and the full release of their title [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/460560]Blamdown: Udder Fury[/url] yesterday. To celebrate this we have added a gorgeous looking cow hat.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25107044/b4f814812e649f5021110153424a3201938817a6.jpg[/img]

And to end on a high note, for the first time in history you can now get Funklift at 20% off for a limited time!

Have fun and keep trucking!!
Victor and the Mostly Harmless Games team

http://store.steampowered.com/app/470140

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Windows 10 gamepad issues
notes.content:
[h1]Hi there![/h1]

We just released an update that should solve the issues with using multiple gamepads on Windows 10. If you encountered them before now might be the time to gather your friends for some lifting.

Have a great weekend.
Victor

notes.title: Release and hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hi all![/h1]

As you might have noticed Funklift was released about 44 hours ago and we completely forgot to post here about it! Better late than never however and to right some wrongs we also give you a small hotfix that should fix some issues.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix gamepad issues where wireless Xbox One controllers were unusable on Windows 10
[*]Catch some debug code that had gotten past our not-so-watchful eyes
[*]Fix keyboard restart from debrief
[*]Fix bonus periods in [i]Get the Funk Out[/i]
[*]Removed obsolete button prompts from settings part of pause menu
[/list]

Have a great weekend and keep trucking!
Victor

notes.title: Free press keys for streamers and youtubers!
notes.content:
[h1]Want to talk, stream or vlog about Funklift?[/h1]
Then you're in luck! Apply for a free Steam key through [url=https://www.keymailer.co/]KeyMailer[/url] and start playing right away!

Keys are sent out asap after we receive your request. Signing up is easy and comfortable for both you and us, the developers :) Give it a try!
